rationale.formal-methods: Autoformalizes agent claims and verifies them with Datalog.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Soufflé deterministically checks formalized claims against verification conditions.
rationale.framework: Reusable analyzer–formalizer–verifier pipeline spans multiple code-reasoning tasks.
rationale.built-system: Implemented and evaluated on MSAN and program-equivalence benchmarks.
rationale.agentic: Tool-using agents perform multi-step exploration and deliver complete reasoning answers.
rationale.risk-security: security: validates reasoning about uninitialized and out-of-bounds memory errors.
rationale.risk-quality: quality: checks semantic equivalence and correctness of code-reasoning judgments.
rationale.risk-overreliance: over-reliance: verification reduces uncritical trust in hallucinated agent explanations.
